title: Structured Agent Output
description: Model-agnostic schema for validating agent responses (can be extended with additional fields)

response.description: The primary response text from the agent

reasoning.description: Optional reasoning or explanation for the response

vote.description: Optional vote or final answer (for judge agents or final round responses)

consensus_check.description: Optional flag indicating if the agent agrees with emerging consensus

references.description: Optional references to other agents' messages that influenced this response
